name: Deploy Employee Management

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Deploy to EC2
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.2.0
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.EC2_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.EC2_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.EC2_SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd ~/EmployeeManagement
            git pull origin master
            ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests
            sudo docker build -t employee-management:latest .
            sudo docker stop employee-management-container || true
            sudo docker rm employee-management-container || true
            sudo docker run -d --name employee-management-container -p 8090:8090 --env-file .env employee-management:latest
